title: Comprehensive Test: AsyncIO & Concurrency (PY_244 to PY_249)

slides.title: AsyncIO & Concurrency Mastery Review
slides.prompt: This test evaluates your mastery across Python concurrency models, including AsyncIO event loop management, coroutines, Tasks, TaskGroups, async queues, blocking code integration, and concurrent.futures executors.
slides.codeSnippet:
import asyncio

async def worker(val):
    await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
    return val * 10

async def main():
    async with asyncio.TaskGroup() as tg:
        t1 = tg.create_task(worker(1))
        t2 = tg.create_task(worker(2))
    print(t1.result() + t2.result())
